notes.title: The Academy Newsletter: June Edition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/51577ab17936ac054fd0243ce32b36eae3b1912f.png[/img]

Hello everyone!!

Happy pride month!!!🌈🌈🌈

We hope everybody is doing well and ready for the weekend!!✨

A few weeks ago we finally got together with the DCP Award, it looks sooo cool in our office :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/92828e5070930c2b7d1ffe27575ff030f1d0f9ef.jpg[/img]

Last month we participated in the indie games festival [url=https://2022.amaze-berlin.de/]AMAZE[/url] in Berlin. It was super nice to see old friends and connect with new indie developers from our city and other parts of Europe.

Annika and Irene even got on stage and gave a presentation about Kraken Academy!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/1b3c351b28f7a040a172fffe71b5c7e892d037bc.jpg[/img]

Something suuuper cool: Kraken Academy!! was featured in the special "Nintendo Dream June 2022 Issue".🌟🤯

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/6005d5685c61e2e770589fd13f3aab1ba32584e0.jpg[/img]

By the way, Kraken Academy is currently [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/kraken-academy-switch/]-25% off on Switch![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/8a1f9277814bc81a97e544979e1877548b3e09a1.png[/img]

Last month we also ran a fanfiction contest! We have sent a Broccoli Girl plushie to the winner @lee/blue for their romance story between a savesnack machine and bottlemachine. You can read it [url=https://www.fanfiction.net/s/14070592/1/Bottle-and-Save-s-undying-love?__cf_chl_tk=pDc_8ueD.M7HXTeli1qlmUqMg0GTRlsWbYD4gDJvz78-1654873638-0-gaNycGzNCdE]here[/url]. Congrats!

The stories of [url=https://www.fanfiction.net/s/14068671/1/I-Beefcake]@AxoLite[/url] and [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QkLBv8vafX6AEdFzKRsfgbciDdr9U4qXmD7aI_km9_Q/edit]@HeckinRobin[/url] also deserve a special mention, as well as the cute fanart from @PanTran - thanks so much for all the love you bring to the community! <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/dd25329b53729df73a4585e514d8818e974022df.jpg[/img]

notes.content:

Hello everyone!!

WOOOOW We still can't believe but we actually won the DCP (German Game Award) for Best Game Design!!! This is a huge deal for us!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/4c8683ca5c9517db9cf376539135b6433cb34e5c.jpg[/img]

And the console launch went also really well!! We've gotten some really cool reviews, [url=https://www.mkaugaming.com/all-review-list/kraken-academy-review/]check this one out[/url]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/10d271e107fd39ee661ee4453a1efccf29a6b5c5.png[/img]

Stream with Valentina from indiestrolche (in German): https://www.twitch.tv/indiestrolche/video/1299945257 (in German)

notes.title: The Academy Newsletter: May Edition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/f2b023949141c85dabbddd6b0ab08b7945d53838.png[/img]

Hello!!

May has been crazy busy for us! We're working super hard on Kraken Academy!! and we finally were able to finish the first full playthrough of the game! We're really happy how everything is coming together and can't wait to show it to the world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/df6bb3986b54b28866e666590d826b94f7fe039c.jpg[/img]

[u]Discord[/u]
We are adding a bunch of new features on our Discord. Now you can select a club when you join and have secret conversations with you fellow club members! We're planning some new additions soon, so come and [url=bit.ly/3c0xBX5]join us[/url]!

[u]Character introductions[/u]
This month we've introduced some important characters:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/d2edd44c7b73610ec18a58143eecf7711b87f36a.png[/img]
There's a million unexplained mysteries out there... hidden forces pulling the strings. 17-year-old conspiracy theorist Kostadin is here to tell you about them, whether you want to hear it or not! Wake up, sheeple!!
Voiced by [url=https://twitter.com/MattRaftisVA]Matt Raftis[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/12b74217202c0b61c52df0f1ef944f8421061631.png[/img]
Ms. Kostova is a militant sports teacher with a no-nonsense attitude. Be prepared to do 50 push-ups with bricks tied to your back as a warm-up!
Voiced by [url=https://twitter.com/AimeeSmithVA]Aimee Smith[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/68878b6f4a1f0906d4ea007deca75fa39755e2aa.png[/img]
Pierre comes from a rich family and loves to mention that he thinks he's superior to others. He is very dramatic and likes to put on a show. He's an amateur magician.
Voiced by [url=https://twitter.com/FishyFried]Molly Zhang[/url]!

[u]Merch[/u]
We've sent some merch around the world to everyone who has worked on the game and it's so great to see it has arrived safely! Thank you for your pics everyone! <3
Keep an eye out for a chance to win some merch soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/dad9f25893d153967de704f29f599d598e70019b.jpg[/img]

[u]What's next?[/u]
We're showing SOMETHING NEW SUPER COOL & SUPER SPECIAL we've been working on for months!
The date is the 5th of June (8am PST/5PM CET) at the [url=https://t.co/VMtFN8DItR?amp=1]Guerrilla Collective Broadcast[/url]!!! Don't miss it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/1ad8c23e70d19201d3c4427ba72ae1aa7afe2cc4.jpg[/img]

And from the 11th until the 22nd of June you will be able to play our [b]updated demo[/b] with [b]new content[/b] as part of the Fellow Traveller Publisher Sale and Steam's Next Fest!!

Thank you for following us! Join our [url=https://twitter.com/happybroccgames]Twitter[/url], [url=bit.ly/3c0xBX5]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/happybroccoligames/]Instagram [/url]for more updates, and don't forget to wishlist!!

notes.title: The Academy Newsletter: March Edition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/538fbdf6e1db95a0d81b12c307be12af3cbe3d03.png[/img]

Hello and welcome to the March edition of the Academy Newsletter! This is what we’ve been working on this month!

[u]Development[/u]
Annika has been writing the dates! This means you will be able to take Broccoli Girl to the newly opened water park, go with Simona to the movies and take Vladimir out to a market fair. 
(This is how Broccoli Girl looks like in a swimsuit :D)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/6833f5818438a7378dd6d6bbb8cd0c06a7f76084.png[/img]
We also finished writing the side quests and we really love how they’ve come together, can’t wait to show them to the world!!
There will be an unusual family reunion, an uprising of the machines and you’ll have to help write a love letter, just to name a few.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/e9d055e1363fd2c8b08ba035008543330f7efab5.png[/img]

Joni has implemented the final scenes of the game, including the final boss battles and has been pottering about the Drama club, fixing up things here and there.
Sneak peek of the Drama Club area:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/2bde4db7077a5be44cb4100dc83066d9b8093564.png[/img]


[u]Character Intros[/u]

This month we’ve introduced Ana and the Player’s Mom!

Ana is a clumsy art student who makes sculptures. She loves her grandma very much and writes her letters every week. She’s voiced by [url=https://twitter.com/LizzieRFreeman]Lizzie Freeman[/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/db9d4836cf800fc9eac9840e9aecb07f8ed30627.png[/img]

The player’s mom is a single mother. Although she does her best, you can tell that your sister is the favourite child. She takes care of your belongings while you're away in boarding school, which results in her selling half of your N69 games and comics. Voiced by [url=https://twitter.com/nolaklop]Nola Klop[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/57fcfbe8f818a0075ef7ddc6a583fb7cbde6f0ea.png[/img]

[u]Merch[/u]

After being stuck in customs for over 3 weeks, the Broccoli Girl pins have finally arrived!!! There will be a chance to win one closer to release, join our [url=http://bit.ly/3c0xBX5]Discord [/url] if you want to know more :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/1edb6489e1071124922959110ed0195496e87ff1.jpg[/img]


We started sending merch to all collaborators in the game: voice over actors, artists, etc. Our printer stopped working so we had to label every envelope by hand D: was a lot of fun though!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/9b1030ac053cdc3c2bd1695851ba601d505b9b68.jpg[/img]


[u]Casting call[/u]

We just announced our latest casting call!!
This time our open roles range from lovely grandma to vampire drama teacher :D

You can [url=https://www.castingcall.club/projects/last-casting-call-for-kraken-academy-2f-2m]apply here[/url] until the 7th of April. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36022497/b58bd2eb140cece88a0b57e0bcdf9842e63bf5ca.png[/img]

[u]Events[/u]

We’re part of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/iwocon2021]IWOCon[/url] which is now live until the 2nd of April, and it’s been so much fun so far!!

Oh and we were also nominated for the [url=http://valenciaindiesummit.com/awards.html]Valencia Indie Awards[/url] :)

So much going on at the moment!! Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/happybroccgames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/happybroccoligames/]Instagram[/url] and [url=http://bit.ly/3c0xBX5]Discord [/url] for the latest news! :D

[previewyoutube=oVBDYvVRp-8;full][/previewyoutube]
